title: Integration by parts on Ω for functions Lipschitz on Ω against C¹ fields compactly supported in Ω
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ open, and let b : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ be C¹ with compact support and tsupport b ⊆ Ω. Then there is a Lebesgue-integrable g : ℝⁿ → ℝ (namely the divergence g = Σ_i ∂_i b_i) with the following property. For every L ≥ 0 and every f : ℝⁿ → ℝ that is L-Lipschitz on Ω: (a) w ↦ f(w)g(w) is Lebesgue integrable on Ω, and (b) ∫_Ω Df(w)(b(w)) dw = −∫_Ω f(w)g(w) dw. Here Df(w) = fderiv ℝ f w (the Fréchet derivative where it exists, 0 otherwise), and integrals are Bochner integrals for Lebesgue measure on ℝⁿ = Eucl n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (b : Eucl n → Eucl n), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ Ω → ∃ g : Eucl n → ℝ, Integrable g (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) ∧ ∀ (L : ℝ≥0) (f : Eucl n → ℝ), LipschitzOnWith L f Ω → IntegrableOn (fun w => f w * g w) Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) ∧ ∫ w in Ω, fderiv ℝ f w (b w) = -∫ w in Ω, f w * g w
